> 40.13A] (8) The court officer of the County Court will enter satisfaction in the County Court records for any sums ordered to be set off, and execution or other process for the enforcement of any judgment or order not wholly satisfied will issue only for the balance remaining payable. ## Judgment in favour of certain part owners relating to the detention of goods

## 40.14

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14] (1) In this rule ‘part owner’ means one of two or more persons who have an interest in the same goods. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14] (2) Where –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14] (a) a part owner makes a claim relating to the detention of the goods; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14] (b) the claim is not based on a right to possession,

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14] any judgment or order given or made in respect of the claim is to be for the payment of damages only, unless the claimant had the written authority of every other part owner of the goods to make the claim on his behalf as well as for himself. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14] (3) This rule applies notwithstanding anything in subsection (3) of section 3 of the Torts (Interference with Goods) Act 1977 5 , but does not affect the remedies and jurisdiction mentioned in subsection (8) of that section. ## County Court certificate of judgment

## 40.14A

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (1) Any person who wishes to have a certificate of any judgment or order given or made in a claim in the County Court (‘the applicant’) may make a request in writing to the court. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (2) If the applicant is a party to the claim, the request must state whether the certificate—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (a) is required for the purpose of taking proceedings on the judgment or order in another court;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (b) is required for the purpose of enforcing the judgment or order in the High Court; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (c) is for the purpose of evidence only. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (3) If the applicant is not a party to the claim, the request must state—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (a) the purpose for which the certificate is required;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (b) the capacity in which the person asks for the certificate; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (c) any other facts showing that the certificate may properly be granted. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (4) Where the certificate is required for the purpose of enforcing the judgment or order in the High Court, the applicant must also either—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (a) state that—

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (i) it is intended to enforce the judgment or order by execution against goods; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (ii) the judgment or order to be enforced is an order for possession of land made in a possession claim against trespassers; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (b) confirm that an application has been made for an order under section 42 of the County Courts Act 1984 6 (transfer to High Court by order of the County Court) and attach a copy of the application to the request for a certificate. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (5) Where the applicant making the request is not a party to the claim, the request will be referred to the District Judge, who may refer it to the judge. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (6) Without prejudice to paragraph (5), for the purposes of section 12(2) of the County Courts Act 1984 7 a certificate under this rule may be signed by a court officer. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.14A] (Rule 83.19 provides for what happens where a request for a certificate of judgment is made under this rule for the purpose of enforcing a judgment or order in the High Court, including (under rule 83.19(4)) that where certain proceedings are pending, the request for the certificate will not be dealt with until those proceedings are determined.)

## Order of appeal court

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Order of appeal court] 40.14B Where the Court of Appeal or High Court has heard and determined an appeal from the County Court, the party entitled to the benefit of the order of the appeal court must deposit the order or an office copy of it in the office of the relevant hearing centre of the County Court. ## II SALE OF LAND ETC. AND CONVEYANCING COUNSEL

## Scope of this Section

## 40.15

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.15] (1) This Section –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.15] (a) deals with the court’s power to order the sale, mortgage, partition or exchange of land; and

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.15] (b) contains provisions about conveyancing counsel. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.15] (Section 131 of the Supreme Court Act 1981 8 (provides for the appointment of the conveyancing counsel of the Supreme Court)

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.15] (2) In this Section ‘land’ includes any interest in, or right over, land. ## Power to order sale etc. ## 40.16 In any proceedings relating to land, the court may order the land, or part of it, to be –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.16 In any proceedings relating to land, the court may order the land, or part of it, to be –] (a) sold;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.16 In any proceedings relating to land, the court may order the land, or part of it, to be –] (b) mortgaged;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.16 In any proceedings relating to land, the court may order the land, or part of it, to be –] (c) exchanged; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.16 In any proceedings relating to land, the court may order the land, or part of it, to be –] (d) partitioned. ## Power to order delivery up of possession etc. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Power to order delivery up of possession etc.] 40.17 Where the court has made an order under rule 40.16, it may order any party to deliver up to the purchaser or any other person –

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Power to order delivery up of possession etc.] (a) possession of the land;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Power to order delivery up of possession etc.] (aa) where the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016 applies, possession of the dwelling;

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Power to order delivery up of possession etc.] (b) receipt of rents or profits relating to it; or

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > Power to order delivery up of possession etc.] (c) both. ## Reference to conveyancing counsel

## 40.18

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.18] (1) The court may direct conveyancing counsel to investigate and prepare a report on the title of any land or to draft any document. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.18] (2) The court may take the report on title into account when it decides the issue in question. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.18] (Provisions dealing with the fees payable to conveyancing counsel are set out in paragraph 5.2 of Practice Direction 44.)

## Party may object to report

## 40.19

[PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.19] (1) Any party to the proceedings may object to the report on title prepared by conveyancing counsel. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.19] (2) Where there is an objection, the issue will be referred to a judge for determination. [PART 40 – JUDGMENTS, ORDERS, SALE OF LAND ETC. > 40.19] (Part 23 contains general rules about making an application)

## III DECLARATORY JUDGMENTS

## Declaratory Judgments

## 40.20 The court may make binding declarations whether or not any other remedy is claimed. ## Footnotes
